summary: Americas Gold & Silver Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results. The filing highlights a 71% increase in net revenue to $46 million, production of 665,000 silver ounces, progress on the Galena Phase 2 shaft upgrade, and settlement of approximately $76 million of variable debt obligations. Operational details include a minor electrical fire impacting production and expectations of meeting full-year guidance of 3.2–3.6 million silver ounces. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, strategic reviews, or corporate actions are disclosed.
